tips.text: Set matchmaking to Solo before entering Pontis Tower to fly your own Railjack; squads always get a loaner.
Raise your Railjack intrinsics first; they still apply on the loaner ship.
Buy a missing part from Hunhow as soon as the Talents cover it; duplicate blueprints never turn back into Talents.
Farm Sirius & Orion in the same runs; the Talents pass 180 Crimson long before the frame is done.
Restart the game if three runs in a row give the same blueprint; the reward table can stick.
Watch for a Mission Failed screen after the boss dies; that run pays nothing.
Bring armor strip or a buff dispel for the fire Sister of Parvos and her Warding Halo, who often spawns here.
Players treat Wrath as mastery fodder rather than a weapon worth building.
Expect one to two hours of missions, plus the foundry timers.
